# Proposed landscape concept generation prompt

Mode: built-in image generation, using the accepted current
`assets/theme_gallery_runtime/variant-f.png` runtime as an identity and palette
reference.

```text
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: approval-gate Android tablet landscape dashboard concept at an exact 1536 x 1024 golden viewport
Input image: Image 1 is the accepted current Containment Drone 47-Alpha runtime reference; preserve its identity and semantic palette, but redesign the composition rather than tracing it.
Primary request: Create a polished, high-fidelity landscape UI concept for the Clinical Calendar theme Containment Drone 47-Alpha. It must read as an integrated Borg-inspired tactical command console: inset mechanical gunmetal housings, shallow squared controls, dense command surfaces, compact uppercase labels, dark black-green interior bays, restrained green status lighting, bone-white data text, amber scheduled state, red urgent state, and unmistakable but original cybernetic industrial identity.
Composition: one continuous full-screen console with a compact command crown at top; a dominant Calendar grid in the central bay; a narrower left Clinical Placements bay; a narrower right progress and Needs Attention bay; a shallow Planning strip below the Calendar; and a compact theme-owned bottom navigation rail. Strong hierarchy and usable negative space. All content remains visibly inside mechanical frames.
Content: use fictional, readable clinical-calendar data only. Include labels CALENDAR, CLINICAL PLACEMENTS, PLANNING, PROGRESS, NEEDS ATTENTION, TODAY, and CONTAINMENT DRONE 47-ALPHA. Calendar should show a plausible month grid with restrained Clinical Session, Work Shift, Protected Day, and Academic Assignment marks.
Style/medium: premium production UI concept, crisp detailed raster mechanical surfaces, subtle wear, front-facing orthographic tablet interface, not pixel art, not a movie still.
Constraints: preserve the semantic meaning of green Clinical Session, muted blue-gray Work Shift, amber scheduled/planning, red urgent, and non-color marks; controls should look implementable with live Flutter widgets; legible at tablet scale; no perspective, no device bezel, no logos from other themes, no Axion delta, no Federation styling, no gradients over text, no excessive neon glow, no baked-in real personal data, no watermark.
```
